title: The Trans-Siberian Railway Historical Journey
description: Hành trình lịch sử trên tuyến đường sắt xuyên Siberia dài nhất thế giới.

coreVocabulary.viDefinition: mang tính sử thi, hoành tráng
coreVocabulary.contextSentence: The Trans-Siberian railway remains the most epic overland journey in history.
Carving rail tracks across permafrost was a monumental feat of engineering.
Watching the endless silver birch forests breeds deep contemplation and solitude.
